bull: Quarterly revenue grew YoY each quarter, reaching 12% in Mar 2026.
EBITDA margin stayed above 18% in FY25 and FY26, showing operational strength.

bear: Failed to achieve the promised highest quarterly growth in Q4 FY26.

Guidance for FY27 EBITDA margin 22‑24% appears ambitious given FY26 performance.
questions: What is the quantitative FY27 revenue target and how does it compare to FY26 actuals?
When will you provide a concrete timeline for achieving 22‑24% EBITDA margin?
